mechanism: Pantoprazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing armodafinil plasma concentrations, while armodafinil may induce CYP3A4 and inhibit CYP2C19, creating bidirectional metabolic competition.
action: Monitor for increased armodafinil effects (insomnia, anxiety, tachycardia) and pantoprazole efficacy changes; consider dose adjustment if adverse effects emerge.
